label: Handhole 4-port
notes: IEC 61753-1 is the performance standard a closure is qualified against - it names the test severities per environment category - and it publishes no port count, tray count or splice capacity. 4 ports, 12 splices and 1 tray are typical of a small pedestal handhole in that category, not a datasheet. Replace with the bought closure's datasheet before ordering.
